plan.notes: Source: official Philander Smith University 'The Major in English (Bachelor of Arts) **Suggested Sequence' PDF (uploaded 2023-12; catalog year inferred as 2023-2024 from the upload date, not printed in the document), personally opened this session. "These course groupings are a template for advisement purposes, but may not reflect actual course offerings for each semester." Grid prints TOTAL 125-129 Hours in Program; sequenced credit sum = 122. Grid note: 'Philander Smith College requires 124 hours for degree completion. The above degree plan allows for an additional 6 Hours of Open Electives to meet the 124 hour requirement.' Mathematics choice range 3-5 seeded at the lower bound. The humanities choice lists 'DRA Intro to Drama' with no course number; seeded with code 'DRA' verbatim. ENG 400 Senior Project prints no credit value; the printed 15-hour senior-first total (3 language + 12 electives) requires 0. ORI 001 Chapel is a printed 0-credit required item repeated across terms per the Philander source — genuine repeated zero-credit requirement.
